units.source_text: 动身那天早晨七点钟，我正在吃早饭，荣吉从马路上呼喊我。

en.t: At seven o'clock on the morning of my departure, while I was eating breakfast, Eikichi called to me from the road.

units.source_text: 他穿了一件带家徽的黑外褂，这身礼服像是为我送行才穿的。

en.t: He was wearing a black haori with his family crest on it, formal clothing that seemed to have been put on just to see me off.
The girls had long since vanished without a trace.

units.source_text: 一种剐心的寂寞从我心底油然而生。

en.t: A heart-rending loneliness welled up naturally from the bottom of my heart.
